schema.name: evidence_records
schema.description: Fetch-level provenance of claims: origin, locator, rights and digests.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the canonical provenance content

properties.name: source_id
properties.description: Qualified source catalogue ID

properties.name: fetch_id
properties.description: Fetch run that retrieved the bytes

properties.name: archive_record_id
properties.description: Raw archive record; null only for review decisions and curated entries

properties.name: origin_uri
properties.description: Origin URI after credential redaction

properties.name: fetched_at
properties.description: UTC fetch or capture time

properties.name: locator_kind
properties.description: Kind of native record locator

properties.name: locator
properties.description: Native locator inside the archived record

properties.name: excerpt
properties.description: Original excerpt, stored only when its rights permit

properties.name: excerpt_rights
properties.description: Rights reference that permits the stored excerpt

properties.name: rights
properties.description: Rights or license policy reference of the evidence

properties.name: code_digest
properties.description: SHA-256 of the parser or mapping code

properties.name: contract_digest
properties.description: Digest of the contract the parser applied

properties.name: curator
properties.description: Curator of a curated observation

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time KN recorded the evidence

schema.name: claims
schema.description: Immutable claims about KN objects with claim-level provenance.

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Deterministic SHA-256 of the claim content and its evidence

properties.name: kn_id
properties.description: KN ID of the object the claim is about

properties.name: field_id
properties.description: Stable contract field ID the claim states

properties.name: conditions_json
properties.description: Canonical JSON object of conditions; {} when unconditioned

properties.name: source_id
properties.description: Qualified source catalogue ID

properties.name: record_id
properties.description: Identity source record that stated the value

properties.name: source_version_id
properties.description: Identity source record version that stated the value

properties.name: change_set_id
properties.description: Identity change set that produced the claim, when tracked

properties.name: change_kind
properties.description: Change that produced the claim

properties.name: supersedes
properties.description: Earlier claim of the same record and field

properties.name: decision_ref
properties.description: Review decision that produced an owner-entered claim

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: Evidence that carries the full provenance

properties.name: fetch_id
properties.description: Fetch ID of the evidence

properties.name: origin_uri
properties.description: Redacted origin URI of the evidence

properties.name: fetched_at
properties.description: UTC fetch time of the evidence

properties.name: original_value
properties.description: Value exactly as the source states it

properties.name: original_unit
properties.description: Unit exactly as the source states it

properties.name: value_text
properties.description: Normalized text value in its original language

properties.name: value_language
properties.description: BCP-47 tag of value_text; und when unknown

properties.name: value_number
properties.description: Exact normalized decimal value

properties.name: value_boolean
properties.description: Normalized boolean value

properties.name: value_date
properties.description: Partial ISO date value

properties.name: value_concept
properties.description: Qualified semantic concept ID value

properties.name: value_kn_id
properties.description: KN ID of a referenced object

properties.name: missing_reason
properties.description: Why no value is stated; exclusive with every value

properties.name: normalized_unit
properties.description: Unit of value_number after conversion

properties.name: conversion_rule
properties.description: Rule that converted the original unit

properties.name: assertion_type
properties.description: How the source asserts the value

properties.name: evidence_class
properties.description: Evidence class used by selection

properties.name: extraction_confidence
properties.description: Extraction confidence from 0 to 1, never a truth probability

properties.name: source_verification_label
properties.description: Imported source verification label; never human verification

properties.name: event_at
properties.description: Time the described event happened (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: event_precision
properties.description: Precision of event_at; present exactly when it is

properties.name: published_at
properties.description: Time the source published the value (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: published_precision
properties.description: Precision of published_at; present exactly when it is

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: Inclusive start of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_from_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_from; present exactly when it is

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: Exclusive end of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_to_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_to; present exactly when it is

properties.name: observed_at
properties.description: UTC time the value was observed

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC knowledge time KN recorded the claim

properties.name: confirmation_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the claim key, source version and fetch

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Unchanged claim that was observed again

properties.name: source_version_id
properties.description: Source record version that repeated the value

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: Evidence of the re-observation

properties.name: fetch_id
properties.description: Fetch ID of the re-observation

properties.name: observed_at
properties.description: UTC time of the re-observation

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time KN recorded the confirmation

schema.name: aliases
schema.description: Weak, non-unique alias identifiers of objects.

properties.name: alias_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the object, text, language and claim

properties.name: kn_id
properties.description: Object the alias weakly identifies

properties.name: alias
properties.description: Alias text exactly as stated

properties.name: language
properties.description: BCP-47 tag of the alias; und when unknown

properties.name: normalized_key
properties.description: Normalized lookup key; not unique

properties.name: normalizer
properties.description: Normalizer that produced the key

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Claim that states the alias

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time KN recorded the alias

schema.name: text_translations
schema.description: Derived translations of text claims; originals stay unchanged.

properties.name: translation_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the claim, language, text and provenance

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Text claim whose original stays unchanged

properties.name: language
properties.description: BCP-47 tag of the translation

properties.name: text
properties.description: Derived translated text

properties.name: method
properties.description: Who produced the translation

properties.name: provenance
properties.description: Source record, review or model and prompt reference

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time KN recorded the translation

schema.name: relation_assertions
schema.description: Typed relations between objects with no active duplicates.

properties.name: assertion_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the relation key and the claim that opened it

properties.name: relation_key
properties.description: SHA-256 of subject, type, object, qualifiers and validity

properties.name: subject_kn_id
properties.description: Subject object

properties.name: relation_type
properties.description: Ontology relation type ID

properties.name: object_kn_id
properties.description: Object at the other endpoint

properties.name: qualifiers_json
properties.description: Canonical JSON object of qualifiers; {} when none

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: Inclusive start of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_from_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_from; present exactly when it is

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: Exclusive end of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_to_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_to; present exactly when it is

properties.name: review_state
properties.description: Review state of the assertion

properties.name: decision_ref
properties.description: Review decision behind the review state

properties.name: opened_by
properties.description: Claim that first asserted the relation

properties.name: opened_at
properties.description: UTC knowledge time the assertion became active

properties.name: closed_at
properties.description: UTC knowledge time the assertion stopped being active

properties.name: close_reason
properties.description: Why the assertion closed

schema.name: relation_supports
schema.description: Claims that support a relation assertion.

properties.name: assertion_id
properties.description: Supported relation assertion

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Claim that supports the assertion

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time KN recorded the support

schema.name: canonical_facts
schema.description: Bitemporal projection of selected claims and unresolved fields.

properties.name: fact_version_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the fact key, selection content and knowledge start

properties.name: fact_key
properties.description: SHA-256 of object, field, conditions and audience

properties.name: kn_id
properties.description: Object of the fact; a survivor after merges

properties.name: field_id
properties.description: Stable contract field ID

properties.name: conditions_json
properties.description: Canonical JSON condition set; {} when unconditioned

properties.name: audience
properties.description: Audience whose eligible evidence was selected

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Selected claim; null when unresolved

properties.name: unresolved_reason
properties.description: Why no claim is selected

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Update policy mode

properties.name: policy_digest
properties.description: SHA-256 of the canonical update policy

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Outcome of the change that produced this version; ignored claims leave no version

properties.name: deciding_criterion
properties.description: Criterion that decided the outcome

properties.name: winner_criteria_json
properties.description: Canonical criteria values of the winner

properties.name: runner_up_criteria_json
properties.description: Canonical criteria values of the runner-up

properties.name: verification_state
properties.description: Derived verification label

properties.name: owner_override
properties.description: An owner-entered value outranks a differing first-party value

properties.name: review_item_id
properties.description: Open review item for this version

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: Inclusive start of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_from_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_from; present exactly when it is

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: Exclusive end of validity (UTC); null when unknown

properties.name: valid_to_precision
properties.description: Precision of valid_to; present exactly when it is

properties.name: knowledge_from
properties.description: Inclusive UTC knowledge time of this version

properties.name: knowledge_to
properties.description: Exclusive UTC knowledge end; null while current

schema.name: selection_outcomes
schema.description: Explained outcome of each claim evaluated by selection.

properties.name: outcome_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the fact version and evaluated claim

properties.name: fact_key
properties.description: Fact whose selection evaluated the claim

properties.name: claim_key
properties.description: Evaluated claim

properties.name: fact_version_id
properties.description: Fact version current after the evaluation

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Explained outcome for the claim

properties.name: criterion
properties.description: Deciding criterion

properties.name: criteria_json
properties.description: Canonical criteria values of the evaluated claim

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: UTC time of the evaluation

schema.name: review_items
schema.description: Candidates, conflicts and quarantine awaiting human review.

properties.name: item_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the kind, subject and sorted candidates

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Registered review item kind

properties.name: kn_id
properties.description: Object under review, when the item has one

properties.name: field_id
properties.description: Field under review, when the item has one

properties.name: fact_key
properties.description: Fact under review, when the item has one

properties.name: candidates_json
properties.description: Canonical sorted array of candidate claim keys or references

properties.name: reason_code
properties.description: Stable reason code

properties.name: opened_by
properties.description: Selection, run or match record that opened the item

properties.name: opened_at
properties.description: UTC time the item opened

schema.name: review_decisions
schema.description: Append-only review decisions with reviewer, reason and times.

properties.name: decision_id
properties.description: SHA-256 of the canonical decision event

properties.name: item_id
properties.description: Decided review item

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Append-only decision outcome

properties.name: selected_claim_key
properties.description: Claim selected by a select decision

properties.name: predecessor
properties.description: Earlier decision this one supersedes

properties.name: reviewer
properties.description: Authenticated reviewer principal

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Reviewer's reason

properties.name: performed_at
properties.description: UTC time of the human decision

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.description: Separate UTC journal recording time

properties.name: human_verification_decision_id

properties.name: event_json
